name: RTK Bridge
description: Detects RTK (Rust Token Killer) on PATH and surfaces install + token-savings status in TEDI's status bar. Pair with the `aiShellPrefix = 'rtk '` preference in Settings → Agents to route TEDI's built-in AI shell tools through RTK for 60–90% token savings. Requires RTK installed separately by the user.
author: IlhamRiski - ilhamriski.com

settings.label: Show savings in status bar tooltip
settings.description: Polls `rtk gain` every 60 seconds and surfaces total tokens saved in the status bar tooltip. Turn off to skip the periodic shell exec.
